master: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent character model sheet for a Windows desktop pet. Reference: MapleStory Ren official appearance. Create a polished clean-lined chibi Ren model sheet, 4 separate full-body views in ONE horizontal row: front neutral sheathed sword; three-quarter facing right hand on sheathed sword; full side facing right walking stance; three-quarter facing right holding drawn slender sword angled forward. Same character in all four views: long white high ponytail with narrow icy blue streak, red eyes, two upright white rabbit ears, black ribbon, white/cream wide-sleeved robe with gold trim and dark navy underclothes, green sash, white stockings, dark boots. Cute large head about half body height, modest outfit faithful to reference. Small readable face and costume, not pixel art. Exactly four characters, transparent background with generous clear gaps between silhouettes, complete ears feet and sword inside each cell, no lettering, labels, logos, scenery, dragon or shadows. Keep all four equal scale.

effects: Transparent VFX sprite sheet for a chibi MapleStory Ren desktop pet. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows on transparent background, twelve isolated effect frames in equal cells, generous clear margins. NO characters, no text, no frames, no ground, no rectangular background. Row1 four progressive phases of a pink-white curved sword slash with delicate plum blossom petals: thin arc starts, sweeping arc broadens, bright arc full sweep, fading drifting petals. Row2 four progressive phases of TWO crossing pale pink and icy-blue blade arcs: first diagonal, crossed X, spreading streaks, fading wisps. Row3 four progressive phases of ONE elegant dark navy serpentine dragon spirit with gold line details and pale icy-blue aura (not a western winged dragon), inspired by Ren companion Saya: faint coiled silhouette, rising dragon head with long curled body, full powerful sweeping dragon with swordlight, dissolving dragon wisps. Continuous transitions within each row. Beautiful crisp painted game effects with true alpha glow, each effect entirely inside its cell. No character bodies or faces except dragon.
